name: ScoreSpec
description: ScoreSpec holds what was measured, on which run, and the result.

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: ID of the run this score grades.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description: ID of the session the run belongs to.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
What is measured: `feedback` for a person's thumbs, `run-health` for
 the free checks.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Who or what gave the score.

fields.name: EvaluatorVersion
fields.description:
Identifies the version of the checks or rubric that produced the
 score, so scores from different versions are never compared as one.

fields.name: Passed
fields.description:
True when the run passed: thumbs up, or every applicable check
 passed.

fields.name: Criteria
fields.description: The criteria behind the value, one per check or rubric item.

fields.name: Comment
fields.description: A person's optional note on their rating.
